description: Dashboard-to-mobile parity manifest (MOBILE_APP_PLAN.md, Parity enforcement). Generated by scripts/mobile/generate-parity-manifest.py; statuses, screens, workstreams, and notes are maintained by hand once an entry exists.

entries.notes: Approvals tab root: the Needs You count and approvals center entry (TUI has the same route)
More tab root: CONFIGURATION, ACTIVITY, SYSTEM, and app settings (phone navigation)
In-app notification history (the dashboard's bell menu), a modal over every tab
Default-password change with Skip (the dashboard shows PasswordChangeRequired in place)
App preferences: theme, language, biometric unlock (device settings, not server settings)
Server profiles: saved Admirals, one active (TUI-style connections)
Sign-in, biometric unlock, and unreachable-server states (the dashboard shows LoginFlow in place)
Approvals badge count (W0.6); the approvals center itself is W1.3
server i18n catalog (/dashboard/i18n/armada.json) fetched after sign-in; the dashboard loads it from its own origin
unauthenticated health probe for a server profile's Test connection button
session validation, admin flags, password-change state
